summary: A Fumadocs-powered Next.js documentation site for the Barkpark JS SDK monorepo, serving MDX content from a content/docs directory with syntax-highlighted code blocks.

intentions.title: Surface JS SDK documentation to developers
intentions.evidence: source.config.ts defines docs/meta from content/docs; lib/source.ts wires Fumadocs loader at /docs baseUrl; next.config.mjs integrates MDX pipeline — together they publish SDK reference docs

intentions.title: Standardise code block presentation with theme-paired syntax highlighting
intentions.evidence: source.config.ts rehypeCodeOptions sets github-light/github-dark themes for light/dark mode parity

intentions.title: Extend Fumadocs default MDX component set for consistent rendering
intentions.evidence: mdx-components.tsx spreads defaultMdxComponents and merges per-page overrides, establishing a single component registry for all doc pages
